Badenoch questions devolution's future, challenges Burnham on Scottish referendum

UK Business Secretary Kemi Badenoch stated that Scottish devolution is a "process and not a religion," suggesting its future is open to discussion. She challenged Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham to rule out a Scottish independence referendum, implying a potential link between devolution in Scotland and England. The comments were made in London.
